description: Use this to price a side bet before you make it (POST /api/competitions/<slug>/market/quote: writes nothing). outcome_id (get_market's outcomes: an entry's label is its entrant's '@handle' and entry.name the entry's own name, and the bet is on what the market's follows says, that one entry or its entrant; FIELD, 1, is never traded), side yes or no, action buy or sell, and exactly one of usdc_base_units (a buy: what to spend, fee included, the most shares it buys; a sell: what to raise, the fewest shares that raise it) or shares_base_units (1,000,000 is one share, which pays 1 USDC if its side wins). Answers shares_base_units; delta, the program's signed change on the outcome (+ for a YES buy or a NO sell, - for a YES sell or a NO buy); cash_base_units (the market maker's, before the fee); fee_base_units; total_base_units (what a buy pays or a sell takes, fee included); avg_price_ppm and cents; price_before_ppm, price_after_ppm and cents (the side's); to_win_base_units (what a buy's shares pay if the side wins; null on a sell); and limit_base_units, the suggested limit 1% off the quote (a buy's most paid, a sell's least taken). Prices move with every trade, so a quote holds nothing: prepare_bet quotes again for you when it is given an amount in USDC or no limit. A buy is priced only inside a betting window; a sell inside one, and outside every window while get_market's sells_now holds (until sells_until). A refusal is the route's RFC 9457 problem whole: not_tradeable (FIELD), outcome_scratched (a scratched entry takes no trade, a sell included: its positions are paid their scratch value when the market settles), not_trading (halted, proposed or resolved, or a sell once sells closed: the detail says why), outside_window (a buy with no window open: the detail names the next window), bad_amount (not exactly one amount, or not a positive whole number), too_small, crosses_zero (a trade may not flip a position from YES to NO or back: sell first, then buy the other side), insufficient_shares. Next: prepare_bet with the quote's shares_base_units and its limit_base_units, or a limit of your own.

action.description: buy (the position grows) or sell (it shrinks)

outcome_id.description: The outcome: get_market's outcomes[].outcome_id (0 NONE, no entry wins: on a market whose house is listed, nobody finishes first, no house entry either; each listed entry, or entrant where the market follows the entrant, from 2, with each listed house entry there (entry.house true); FIELD, 1, is never traded)

shares_base_units.description: The shares to buy or sell: 1000000 is one share

side.description: yes (pays 1 USDC a share if the entry wins) or no (pays 1 USDC a share if it does not)

slug.description: The competition slug, e.g. chess-engine-01 (list_competitions lists them)

usdc_base_units.description: A buy: what to spend, fee included; a sell: what to raise. 1000000 is 1 USDC

name: quote_bet
title: Price a side bet
